commanders.name: Y'shtola, Night's Blessed
commanders.blurb: Esper control: each noncreature spell with mana value 3 or more deals 2 damage and gains 2 life; draw cards at end of turn.
starter: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

commanders.name: Teval, the Balanced Scale
commanders.blurb: Sultai graveyard: Teval mills on attack, returns lands and makes Zombies whenever cards leave the graveyard.

commanders.name: Fire Lord Azula
commanders.blurb: Grixis aggro: Azula makes mana on attack and copies every spell you cast during combat.

commanders.name: Cloud, Ex-SOLDIER
commanders.blurb: Naya equipment: Cloud equips on entry, draws for each equipped creature and makes Treasures.

commanders.name: Ureni of the Unwritten
commanders.blurb: Temur Dragons: whenever Ureni enters or attacks, put a Dragon from the top eight cards onto the battlefield.

commanders.name: Karolina Dean, Runaway
commanders.blurb: Five-color Marvel hero: flies, and every turn makes WUBRG that pays for exiled cards, abilities and anything not cast from the hand.

commanders.name: Pantlaza, Sun-Favored
commanders.blurb: Naya Dinosaurs: each Dinosaur that enters discovers a free spell based on its toughness.

commanders.name: Jace, Multiverse Architect
commanders.blurb: Four-color planeswalker: Jace draws cards, protects himself from attacks and transforms creatures with Polymorph.

commanders.name: The Wise Mothman
commanders.blurb: Sultai radiation: everyone gets rad counters; each milled nonland card adds +1/+1 counters.

commanders.name: Shang-Chi, Master of Kung Fu
commanders.blurb: Bonus commander: activate creature abilities immediately as though they had haste; Shang-Chi makes two mana for creature abilities.

commanders.name: Teysa Karlov
commanders.blurb: Aristocrats: sacrifice expendable creatures, double death triggers, drain life and rebuild your board.

commanders.name: Breya, Etherium Shaper
commanders.blurb: Artifact engine: build Thopters, recycle artifacts and turn expendable machines into damage and control. No Voltron plan.

commanders.name: Eriette of the Charmed Apple
commanders.blurb: Aura control: charm opposing creatures so they cannot attack you; each Aura fuels your end-step life drain.

cards.n: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose
